if ARCH_POSIX
source "arch/posix/Kconfig"
else
rsource "arch/$(ARCH)/Kconfig"
endif

menu "Architecture-related options"

config ARCH_HAS_CUSTOM_SWAP_TO_MAIN
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a custom
	  implementation of z_swap_to_main_thread, and that the
	  generic implementation in kernel/swap.c should not be built.

config ARCH_HAS_CUSTOM_BUSY_WAIT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a custom
	  implementation of k_busy_wait, and that the generic
	  implementation in kernel/spin_wait.c should not be built.

config ARCH_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has its own
	  implementation of the timing functions.

config ARCH_HAS_STACK_PROTECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports kernel stack
	  canaries.

config ARCH_HAS_USERSPACE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports memory
	  domains and userspace.

config ARCH_HAS_MEMORY_REGION_MPU
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an MPU driver that
	  can be used to implement memory protection for memory regions.

config ARCH_HAS_RAMFUNC_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports copying functions
	  to RAM and executing them from there.

config ARCH_HAS_NESTED_EXCEPTION_DETECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a way to detect
	  if it is currently running in an exception context, and if that
	  exception has preempted another exception.

config ARCH_HAS_RESERVED_PAGE_FRAMES
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has reserved page frames
	  that should not be used by the page allocator.

config ARCH_HAS_COVERAGE_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has coverage support.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_ABORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has support for aborting
	  a thread.

config ARCH_HAS_LAZY_REG_STACK_SWITCH
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has support for lazy
	  register switching on context switch.

config ARCH_HAS_ADDITIONAL_CRITICAL_EXIT_CHECKS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has support for
	  additional checks in the exit of a critical section.

config ARCH_HAS_GDBSTUB
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has support for gdbstub.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE
	bool
	help

	  local storage.

config ARCH_HAS_SW_VECTOR_RELAY
	bool
	help

	  vector relay.

config ARCH_HAS_EXTRA_EXCEPTION_INFO
	bool
	help

config ARCH_HAS_SYSCALL_INLINE
	bool
	help

	  syscalls.

config ARCH_HAS_NANO_ESF
	bool
	help

	bool

# Kernel objects
# ==============

config K_OBJECT_BYTES_TO_BITS
	int
	default 8
	help
	  This option specifies the number of bits in a byte.

config MAX_THREAD_BYTES
	int "Maximum thread size (in bytes)"
	help
	  This option specifies the maximum size of a thread object, which
	  may grow depending on which kernel features are enabled. This is
	  not user-configurable and is derived from other Kconfig options.

config K_THREAD_SIZEOF
	int
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of a thread object.

config K_SEM_SIZEOF
	int
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of a semaphore object.

config K_MUTEX_SIZEOF
	int
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of a mutex object.

config K_CONDVAR_SIZEOF
	int
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of a condition variable object.

config K_MSGQ_SIZEOF
	int
	default 0
	help

config K_MBOX_SIZEOF
	int
	default 0
